# Platform parity checklist (R-13)

One row per v1 feature in `docs/02-prd.md` (its `[Fx.y]` ID) × iPhone, Android, macOS and web.
`test/policy/parity_checklist_test.dart` fails CI when a PRD ID has no row, a row has no PRD ID, a
cell has no evidence, a cited file is missing, a "later"/"gap" cell names no existing plan task, or
this file is stale. It is the 08 §6.2 release gate: every cell ✓ (or n/a, or an owner gate that is
ticked in 08 §6.1) before a tag.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✓ CI | Automated tests below cover it on this target (shared Dart code runs the same on all four; all four targets build in CI) |
| ✓ device | Also run on a simulator, emulator, the Mac or Chrome — the note says when |
| ◐ owner | Needs the owner: accounts, consoles or physical hardware (08 §6.1) |
| ◐ manual | Needs a person at the screen; a person check in 08 §6.1 E |
| → later | Not built yet by plan; the note names the task |
| — n/a | Not on this target by spec |
| ✗ gap | Missing with no recorded decision; the note names the plan task that closes it |

## Notes

- **F1.1** Concept A thread (ADR-0007): Wake Up → Bedtime with the now dot; the three-day spread from 840 px; Mac and web pixel-identical at 1280.
- **F1.2** Resize is the end grip only (M3b.5); the start moves with the task. Touch holds 250 ms, a mouse lifts at once (`today_spread_test`).
- **F1.3** Touch: second finger toggles the chip (device runs); desktop: Alt.
- **F1.5** Pinned switch in the task sheet (this occurrence) and the editor (Save asks about the series), M8.4b; pins are honoured by the scheduler, drag and Running late.
- **F1.6** One day at a time (M3b.7); desktop adds Shift/⌘/Ctrl-click.
- **F1.8** Days step with ⌘/Ctrl+←/→ (07 macOS, 10 §4), not bare arrows; the Mac Go menu does the same. In a browser ⌘← may be Back — checked by hand.
- **F1.9** The done haptic is felt only on a phone (08 §6.1 hardware pass).
- **F1.10** Time, title, icon and colour show on every row; subtask progress on the live row and the sheet (10 §3); an imported event carries the calendar glyph in its meta and "from your calendar" in its label (M8.4b).
- **F1.11** Lift haptic needs a physical phone (08 §6.1 hardware pass); edge auto-scroll is Flutter's `EdgeDraggingAutoScroller`.
- **F1.12** Web calendar events come from Google/Microsoft (F5.1).
- **F1.13** Recorded in PRD F1.13 (M8.4b): the thread lists overlaps in start order with the live overrun (Shift the rest); the Week board stacks them. No side-by-side columns on the one-axis thread.
- **F1.14** `thread_perf_test` needs `flutter drive --profile` on hardware (M5.9b); the thread is a sliver (lazy) on every target.
- **F1.15** Per-weekday Wake Up/Bedtime (M3d.3); tasks before Wake Up / after Bedtime fold into a row beyond the cap that unfolds on tap (M8.4b).
- **F1.16** Bedtime 23:55 (the latest) with a 23:30 task, scrolled to the end, on the phone pager and the Mac/web spread (M8.4b).
- **F1.17** Tab/Enter open, Enter/Space done, ⌘/Ctrl+D, ⌘/Ctrl+←/→/T, Esc (M3e.6); ↑↓ pick, ⌘/Ctrl+↑↓ move 5 (Shift 15), Delete → Trash with Undo, ↩ open, Space done on the pick (M8.4b, the multi-select model).
- **F2.2** A real clipboard paste on a phone is in the 08 §6.1 hardware pass.
- **F2.3** Sheet below 840 px, side panel above — by width, not platform.
- **F2.7** Presets are editable, default 15 30 45 1 h 1.5 h 2 h (M3c.3).
- **F2.9** Built with the PRD limits: title, notes (links tap), start, duration, colour, icon, subtasks, alerts, repeat, travel buffer, pinned (M8.4b); energy chips and markdown-lite notes rendered in the sheet (M8.4c).
- **F2.11** Data (M6.5.1), order and reorder (M3f.3), actual end on Done (M6.5.2), step lengths and "Length = sum of steps" in the editor (M10.3), actual start on opening Focus (M10.5).
- **F3.1** Schedule sheet with suggestions everywhere; drag onto Today from the wide sidebar (≥ 840 px, M3e.2). Compact/medium place by dragging on the Schedule sheet's thread (PRD F3.1, M8.4c).
- **F3.2** Wide: +, right-click and screen-reader actions replace swipes (M3e.2).
- **F3.3** Count on the Inbox tab/rail at every width, in the header and the Inbox widget; the plan-your-inbox card on Today, off by default (M8.4c).
- **F4.5** New York spring/fall cases added in M8.4 (Berlin existed).
- **F4.6** Mac and web refresh on start, resume and every 6 h while open (M5.2, M6.5.6); web offline via the service worker (CI pwa_check).
- **F5.1** Device calendars on iPhone/Android (EventKit, CalendarContract) and the Mac (EventKit channel, M7.1b); Google/Microsoft on all four through the backend (owner gate: OAuth clients); Apple on web via CalDAV is Phase 2 (07 Web).
- **F5.4** Invitees kept on a real iPhone: owner gate (08 §6.1).
- **F5.5** A rule on the device, no routing service (M7.5): same Dart on all four.
- **F6.1** Minutes before are a fixed set 5/10/15/30/60 (M3f.2 decision).
- **F6.2** M8.4d: default set (up to 5) in the Alerts editor; Quiet hours (loud first dot still rings); day-start summary per weekday at Wake Up, skipped on an empty day; Apple keeps the nearest 50 pending.
- **F6.4** Web system notifications carry Done and Open (Chrome shows two actions, M5.3a); the in-app strip offers Done and Snooze 10 min (M8.4d).
- **F6.6** M8.4d: Dot, Chime, Bell, Ripple (tool/gen_sounds.dart) or the system sound. M15 (docs/12, ADR-0015): 48 bundled sounds, a sound per task, a Start sound for loud dots, a Done sound; Android one channel per sound (45), Apple a .caf per notification, the web plays it in the in-app strip. Focus/DND respected (time-sensitive on Apple, health panel M6.5.8 names a muted sound channel).
- **F7.2** Email link verified on the iPhone sim, Android emulator and Chrome (M6.1); Apple and Google need the owner's console set-up on all four; the Mac email link is in the 08 §6.1 Mac run.
- **F7.3** Background sync on phones; Mac and web sync while open (M6.5.6). Offline-day and two-device scenarios on all four: 08 §6.2.
- **F7.4** Concept A shows a status line, not a pill (M6.3).
- **F7.5** Share sheet on phones, save panel on the Mac, downloads on web (M8.1); logic is CI-tested, the system sheets need a person.
- **F7.7** Confirmation email needs `delete-account` deployed with mail secrets (08 §6.1 Supabase project).
- **F8.1** Week board from 840 px; phones use the week strip + Month (10 §5.2 W1).
- **F8.3** Web shows "Uses your computer's lock" instead of App lock (07 Web). Four Concept A accents on every target; no Android dynamic accent (PRD F8.3, M8.4c).
- **F10.1** Real OS permission prompts are in the 08 §6.1 hardware pass.
- **F11.1** Recipient feedback@dottoday.app, compiled in (chore/final-ids).
